title: The care facility world
content: Well, here's a new one for you all. This dream was interesting for multiple reasons. One being the new expansion on the "Mall World" concept (like "Hotel World" and "School World" for instance) and the other being the connections to my real world, and to another dream I had about a [theme park](https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/1585zzj/another_theme_park/). I work for a caregiving agency IRL. In the dream, my agency had decided to send me to this small town, to the north of where I live by about an hour. (I looked it up. It doesn't actually exist.) Instead of visiting people's homes every day for a shift, I would be "stationed" there for a month. The town was called Pelau, and it was designed as a gigantic "care facility". Instead of having people live in an assisted living apartment, it was more like an entire assisted living town. There were houses, a grocery store, a library, a doctor's office...all sorts of things. The roads to the town were just wrong. Traffic would go the wrong way, people would drive in the turning lanes, roads would unexpectedly end, and when I finally got close to the town, it went from flat open roads to narrow, winding, hilly ones. When I made it into the town and parked in a lot, I noticed something. This was the same area that the theme park dream from before took place in. Like, one of the multiple roads leading away from the park definitely ended up here. I just knew that to be true. As I looked around the town for the house I was assigned to, I checked out some of the buildings, since I had a lot of time before I needed to show up for work. I entered the library, which didn't look like a library, I think this must have been a lobby or hangout area in the front. I found a huge water slide and went down it and it took me to the convention center where the "Wheel of Time" lecture had been given in the other dream, and it confirmed what I thought about these places being connected. I explored the building, which was completely empty, some more and found a library in the back. As I looked around, checking out these tall shelves made of dark wood and full of old books, I opened a door. Guess where it went? Right back to the lobby area.
